title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
[DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017)](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017) is now available on Unity Gateway with text and image inputs. See [supported regions](/aws/en/unity-gateway/model-region-availability). You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
